I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

The allotments of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No.Ma/GLW/2016/395 and dated 12.04.2017, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village of Nabadagahawatta in the GramaNiladhari Division of No. E 431 E Nabadagahawatta in the DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Galewela in Matale District in CentralProvince and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Indigolla Jungle – Extent: 0.0130 HectareNorth: Canal and Indigolla claimed by claimant unknown; East:Indigolla claimed by claimant unknown, Indigolla claimed byM. H. M. Nausar and Lot B; South: Lot B, Indigolla claimed by
M. H. M. Nausar and Indigolla claimed by claimant unknown; West:Indigolla claimed by claimant unknown and Canal.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Indigolla Paddyfield – Extent: 0.0746 HectareNorth: Lot A, Indigolla claimed by claimant unknown and Indigollaclaimed by M. H. M. Nausar; East and South: Indigolla claimed byM. H. M. Nausar; West: Indigolla claimed by M. H. M. Nausar,Indigolla claimed by claimant unknown and Canal.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My No.: 4-3/9/2015/IR/307J.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.22nd July, 2018.
